remarks: Enjoy scenic surroundings and affordable suburban living in this beautifully updated, move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath center-unit townhome in the heart of Derby, located in the Lake Shore School District! Offering 1,260 sq. ft. plus a 588-sq.-ft. partially finished walk-out basement, this home features brand-new luxury vinyl flooring throughout, fresh paint, newer lighting fixtures, newer windows, and central air. The eat-in kitchen includes stainless steel appliances and a walk-in pantry, while the spacious living room overlooks an open green area with no rear neighbors. Upstairs, you’ll find three generously sized bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with a spacious walk-in closet, along with an updated full bathroom with tile finishes. An attached one-car garage, ample closets, and basement space provide plenty of storage. The walk-out basement offers flexible space, a laundry area with washer and dryer included, and access to a large, fully fenced concrete patio—perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Pets are allowed, and affordable quarterly HOA fees include exterior maintenance for easy, low-maintenance living. Conveniently located near Lake Erie, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, with easy access to Hamburg and downtown Buffalo! Also listed under MLS#B1719177.
